1	/**
2	 * APOD Proxy — Cloudflare Worker
3	 *
4	 * Serves NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day from a stable URL.
5	 * Uses Cloudflare's edge cache for both the API response and the
6	 * image bytes — no KV, no cron, no external storage.
7	 *
8	 * Routes:
9	 *   GET /          → today's APOD image (high res, falls back to standard)
10	 *   GET /sd        → today's APOD image (standard res)
11	 *   GET /optimized → optimized image (≤1200px, auto WebP/AVIF)
12	 *   GET /thumb     → tiny thumbnail (32px, blurred WebP)
13	 *   GET /info      → JSON metadata (includes image dimensions)
14	 *   GET /about     → plain-text description and attribution
15	 *   GET /date      → today's APOD date (plain text)
16	 *   GET /title     → today's APOD title (plain text)
17	 *   GET /explanation → today's APOD explanation (plain text)
18	 *   GET /copyright → copyright holder or "none" (plain text)

25	const NASA_APOD_URL = "https://api.nasa.gov/planetary/apod";
26	const MAX_LOOKBACK_DAYS = 7;
27	const CACHE_TTL = 21600;      // 6 hours — APOD changes once/day
28	const STALE_CACHE_TTL = 86400; // 24 hours — fallback when NASA API is down/rate-limited
29

31	  date: string;

43	  }
44	}

46	const inflightApod = new Map<string, Promise<ApodResponse>>();
47	
48	function apodCacheUrl(key: string): string {
49	  return `https://api.nasapicture.com/_cache/apod/${key}`;
50	}
51	
52	function todayET(): string {
53	  return new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-CA", { timeZone: "America/New_York" });
54	}

56	async function fetchApod(log: string[], apiKey: string, date?: string): Promise<ApodResponse> {
57	  const resolvedDate = date ?? todayET();
58	  const cacheKey = resolvedDate;
59	
60	  const cache = caches.default;
61	  const cacheReq = new Request(apodCacheUrl(cacheKey));
62	  const staleReq = new Request(apodCacheUrl(`${cacheKey}:stale`));
63	
64	  const cached = await cache.match(cacheReq);
65	  if (cached) {
66	    log.push(`  [fetchApod] ${cacheKey} → cache HIT`);
67	    return cached.json() as Promise<ApodResponse>;
68	  }
69	
70	  // Deduplicate concurrent requests for the same date
71	  const inflight = inflightApod.get(cacheKey);
72	  if (inflight) {
73	    log.push(`  [fetchApod] ${cacheKey} → coalesced with in-flight request`);
74	    return inflight;
75	  }
76	
77	  const promise = fetchApodFromNasa(log, apiKey, resolvedDate, cacheKey, cacheReq, staleReq);
78	  inflightApod.set(cacheKey, promise);
79	  try {
80	    return await promise;
81	  } finally {
82	    inflightApod.delete(cacheKey);
83	  }
84	}
85	
86	async function fetchApodFromNasa(
87	  log: string[], apiKey: string, resolvedDate: string, cacheKey: string,
88	  cacheReq: Request, staleReq: Request,
89	): Promise<ApodResponse> {
90	  const cache = caches.default;
91	  const url = `${NASA_APOD_URL}?api_key=${apiKey}&date=${resolvedDate}`;
92	
93	  const res = await fetch(url);
94	
95	  const cfCache = res.headers.get("cf-cache-status") ?? "none";
96	  log.push(`  [fetchApod] ${cacheKey} → ${res.status} (cf-cache: ${cfCache})`);
97	
98	  if (!res.ok) {
99	    const body = await res.text();
100	    log.push(`  [fetchApod] body=${body}`);
101	
102	    // Try stale cache before giving up
103	    const stale = await cache.match(staleReq);
104	    if (stale) {
105	      log.push(`  [fetchApod] ${cacheKey} → stale cache fallback`);
106	      return stale.json() as Promise<ApodResponse>;
107	    }
108	
109	    throw new NasaApiError(res.status,
110	      res.status === 429
111	        ? "NASA API rate limit exceeded — try again later"
112	        : `NASA API returned ${res.status}`

114	  }
115	
116	  const apod = await res.json() as ApodResponse;
117	  const body = JSON.stringify(apod);

119	  const staleHeaders = { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Cache-Control": `public, max-age=${STALE_CACHE_TTL}` };
120	  await Promise.all([
121	    cache.put(cacheReq, new Response(body, { headers: cacheHeaders })),
122	    cache.put(staleReq, new Response(body, { headers: staleHeaders })),
123	  ]);
124	  return apod;
125	}

127	async function findLatestImage(log: string[], apiKey: string): Promise<ApodResponse> {
128	  let videos = 0;
129	  let errors = 0;
130	
131	  for (let i = 0; i <= MAX_LOOKBACK_DAYS; i++) {
132	    const d = new Date();
133	    d.setDate(d.getDate() - i);
134	    const date = d.toLocaleDateString("en-CA", { timeZone: "America/New_York" });
135	
136	    try {
137	      const apod = await fetchApod(log, apiKey, date);
138	      if (apod.media_type === "image") return apod;
139	      videos++;
140	    } catch (err) {
141	      errors++;
142	      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "unknown";
143	      log.push(`  [findLatestImage] ${date} → error, skipping (${msg})`);
144	    }
145	  }
146	
147	  throw new Error(
148	    `No image found in last ${MAX_LOOKBACK_DAYS + 1} days (${videos} videos, ${errors} errors)`
149	  );
150	}

287	export default {
288	  async fetch(request: Request, env: Env): Promise<Response> {
289	    if (request.method === "OPTIONS") {

293	          "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET, HEAD, OPTIONS",

302	        { status: 405, headers: { "Allow": "GET, HEAD, OPTIONS", "Content-Type": "application/json" } },
303	      );
304	    }
305	
306	    const reqUrl = new URL(request.url);

2	 * APOD Proxy — Cloudflare Worker
3	 *
4	 * Serves NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day from a stable URL.

8	 * Routes:

10	 *   GET /sd        → today's APOD image (standard res)
11	 *   GET /optimized → optimized image (≤1200px, auto WebP/AVIF)

23	}

25	const NASA_APOD_URL = "https://api.nasa.gov/planetary/apod";
26	const MAX_LOOKBACK_DAYS = 7;
27	const CACHE_TTL = 21600;      // 6 hours — APOD changes once/day
28	const STALE_CACHE_TTL = 86400; // 24 hours — fallback when NASA API is down/rate-limited
29	
30	interface ApodResponse {
31	  date: string;
32	  title: string;
33	  explanation: string;
34	  url: string;
35	  hdurl?: string;
36	  media_type: "image" | "video";
37	  copyright?: string;
38	}

40	class NasaApiError extends Error {
41	  constructor(public statusCode: number, message: string) {
42	    super(message);
43	  }
44	}
45	
46	const inflightApod = new Map<string, Promise<ApodResponse>>();
47	
48	function apodCacheUrl(key: string): string {
49	  return `https://api.nasapicture.com/_cache/apod/${key}`;
50	}
51	
52	function todayET(): string {
53	  return new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-CA", { timeZone: "America/New_York" });
54	}
55	
56	async function fetchApod(log: string[], apiKey: string, date?: string): Promise<ApodResponse> {
57	  const resolvedDate = date ?? todayET();
58	  const cacheKey = resolvedDate;
59	
60	  const cache = caches.default;
61	  const cacheReq = new Request(apodCacheUrl(cacheKey));
62	  const staleReq = new Request(apodCacheUrl(`${cacheKey}:stale`));
63	
64	  const cached = await cache.match(cacheReq);
65	  if (cached) {
66	    log.push(`  [fetchApod] ${cacheKey} → cache HIT`);
67	    return cached.json() as Promise<ApodResponse>;
68	  }
69	
70	  // Deduplicate concurrent requests for the same date
71	  const inflight = inflightApod.get(cacheKey);
72	  if (inflight) {
73	    log.push(`  [fetchApod] ${cacheKey} → coalesced with in-flight request`);
74	    return inflight;
75	  }
76	
77	  const promise = fetchApodFromNasa(log, apiKey, resolvedDate, cacheKey, cacheReq, staleReq);
78	  inflightApod.set(cacheKey, promise);
79	  try {
80	    return await promise;
81	  } finally {
82	    inflightApod.delete(cacheKey);
83	  }
84	}
85	
86	async function fetchApodFromNasa(
87	  log: string[], apiKey: string, resolvedDate: string, cacheKey: string,
88	  cacheReq: Request, staleReq: Request,
89	): Promise<ApodResponse> {
90	  const cache = caches.default;
91	  const url = `${NASA_APOD_URL}?api_key=${apiKey}&date=${resolvedDate}`;
92	
93	  const res = await fetch(url);
94	
95	  const cfCache = res.headers.get("cf-cache-status") ?? "none";
96	  log.push(`  [fetchApod] ${cacheKey} → ${res.status} (cf-cache: ${cfCache})`);
97	
98	  if (!res.ok) {
99	    const body = await res.text();
100	    log.push(`  [fetchApod] body=${body}`);
101	
102	    // Try stale cache before giving up
103	    const stale = await cache.match(staleReq);
104	    if (stale) {
105	      log.push(`  [fetchApod] ${cacheKey} → stale cache fallback`);
106	      return stale.json() as Promise<ApodResponse>;
107	    }
108	
109	    throw new NasaApiError(res.status,
110	      res.status === 429
111	        ? "NASA API rate limit exceeded — try again later"
112	        : `NASA API returned ${res.status}`
113	    );
114	  }
115	
116	  const apod = await res.json() as ApodResponse;
117	  const body = JSON.stringify(apod);
118	  const cacheHeaders = { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Cache-Control": `public, max-age=${CACHE_TTL}` };
119	  const staleHeaders = { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Cache-Control": `public, max-age=${STALE_CACHE_TTL}` };
120	  await Promise.all([
121	    cache.put(cacheReq, new Response(body, { headers: cacheHeaders })),
122	    cache.put(staleReq, new Response(body, { headers: staleHeaders })),
123	  ]);
124	  return apod;
125	}

127	async function findLatestImage(log: string[], apiKey: string): Promise<ApodResponse> {
128	  let videos = 0;
129	  let errors = 0;
130	
131	  for (let i = 0; i <= MAX_LOOKBACK_DAYS; i++) {
132	    const d = new Date();
133	    d.setDate(d.getDate() - i);
134	    const date = d.toLocaleDateString("en-CA", { timeZone: "America/New_York" });
135	
136	    try {
137	      const apod = await fetchApod(log, apiKey, date);
138	      if (apod.media_type === "image") return apod;
139	      videos++;
140	    } catch (err) {
141	      errors++;
142	      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "unknown";
143	      log.push(`  [findLatestImage] ${date} → error, skipping (${msg})`);
144	    }
145	  }
146	
147	  throw new Error(
148	    `No image found in last ${MAX_LOOKBACK_DAYS + 1} days (${videos} videos, ${errors} errors)`
149	  );
150	}

152	function validateImageUrl(url: string): void {
153	  const parsed = new URL(url);
154	  if (parsed.protocol !== "https:") {
155	    throw new Error(`Blocked image fetch: non-HTTPS scheme (${parsed.protocol})`);
156	  }
157	  if (!parsed.hostname.endsWith(".nasa.gov")) {
158	    throw new Error(`Blocked image fetch: unexpected host (${parsed.hostname})`);
159	  }
160	}

162	async function fetchImageCached(log: string[], url: string): Promise<Response> {
163	  validateImageUrl(url);
164	
165	  const cache = caches.default;
166	  const cacheReq = new Request(`https://api.nasapicture.com/_cache/image/${encodeURIComponent(url)}`);

168	
169	  const cached = await cache.match(cacheReq);
170	  if (cached) {
171	    log.push(`  [fetchImage] ${url.slice(0, 80)}… → cache HIT`);
172	    return cached;

175	  const res = await fetch(url);

179	  if (!res.ok) {
180	    // Try stale cache before giving up
181	    const stale = await cache.match(staleReq);
182	    if (stale) {
183	      log.push(`  [fetchImage] ${url.slice(0, 80)}… → stale cache fallback`);
184	      return stale;
185	    }
186	    throw new Error(`Image fetch failed: ${res.status}`);
187	  }

189	  const contentType = res.headers.get("Content-Type") || "image/jpeg";
190	  const contentLength = res.headers.get("Content-Length");
191	  const cacheHeaders: Record<string, string> = {

212	async function fetchImageDimensions(log: string[], imageUrl: string): Promise<ImageDimensions | null> {
213	  validateImageUrl(imageUrl);
214	
215	  const cache = caches.default;
216	  const cacheKey = `https://api.nasapicture.com/_cache/dimensions/${encodeURIComponent(imageUrl)}`;
217	  const cacheReq = new Request(cacheKey);
218	  const staleReq = new Request(`${cacheKey}:stale`);
219	
220	  const cached = await cache.match(cacheReq);
221	  if (cached) {
222	    log.push(`  [dimensions] ${imageUrl.slice(0, 80)}… → cache HIT`);
223	    return cached.json() as Promise<ImageDimensions>;
224	  }
225	
226	  try {
227	    const res = await fetch(imageUrl, {
228	      cf: { image: { format: "json" } },
229	    });
230	
231	    if (!res.ok) {
232	      const stale = await cache.match(staleReq);
233	      if (stale) {
234	        log.push(`  [dimensions] ${imageUrl.slice(0, 80)}… → stale cache fallback`);
235	        return stale.json() as Promise<ImageDimensions>;
236	      }
237	      log.push(`  [dimensions] ${imageUrl.slice(0, 80)}… → ${res.status} (failed)`);
238	      return null;
239	    }
240	
241	    const info = await res.json() as { original: { width: number; height: number } };
242	    const dimensions: ImageDimensions = {
243	      width: info.original.width,
244	      height: info.original.height,
245	    };
246	
247	    log.push(`  [dimensions] ${imageUrl.slice(0, 80)}… → ${dimensions.width}×${dimensions.height}`);
248	
249	    const body = JSON.stringify(dimensions);
250	    await Promise.all([
251	      cache.put(cacheReq, new Response(body, {
252	        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Cache-Control": `public, max-age=${CACHE_TTL}` },
253	      })),
254	      cache.put(staleReq, new Response(body, {
255	        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Cache-Control": `public, max-age=${STALE_CACHE_TTL}` },
256	      })),
257	    ]);
258	    return dimensions;
259	  } catch (err) {
260	    log.push(`  [dimensions] ${imageUrl.slice(0, 80)}… → error: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : "unknown"}`);
261	    const stale = await cache.match(staleReq);
262	    if (stale) return stale.json() as Promise<ImageDimensions>;
263	    return null;
264	  }
265	}

267	function baseHeaders(origin: string, headers: Record<string, string> = {}): Record<string, string> {
268	  return {
269	    "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
270	    "Cache-Control": `public, max-age=${CACHE_TTL}`,
271	    "Link": [
272	      `<${origin}/>; rel="alternate"; type="image/*"; title="HD image"`,
273	      `<${origin}/sd>; rel="alternate"; type="image/*"; title="SD image"`,
274	      `<${origin}/optimized>; rel="alternate"; type="image/*"; title="Optimized image"`,
275	      `<${origin}/thumb>; rel="alternate"; type="image/webp"; title="Thumbnail"`,
276	      `<${origin}/info>; rel="describedby"`,
277	      `<${origin}/about>; rel="about"`,
278	      `<${origin}/date>; rel="describedby"; title="APOD date"`,
279	      `<${origin}/title>; rel="describedby"; title="APOD title"`,
280	      `<${origin}/explanation>; rel="describedby"; title="APOD explanation"`,
281	      `<${origin}/copyright>; rel="describedby"; title="APOD copyright"`,
282	    ].join(", "),
283	    ...headers,
284	  };
285	}

56	async function fetchApod(log: string[], apiKey: string, date?: string): Promise<ApodResponse> {
57	  const resolvedDate = date ?? todayET();
58	  const cacheKey = resolvedDate;
59	
60	  const cache = caches.default;
61	  const cacheReq = new Request(apodCacheUrl(cacheKey));
62	  const staleReq = new Request(apodCacheUrl(`${cacheKey}:stale`));

66	    log.push(`  [fetchApod] ${cacheKey} → cache HIT`);
67	    return cached.json() as Promise<ApodResponse>;

71	  const inflight = inflightApod.get(cacheKey);

162	async function fetchImageCached(log: string[], url: string): Promise<Response> {
163	  validateImageUrl(url);
164	
165	  const cache = caches.default;
166	  const cacheReq = new Request(`https://api.nasapicture.com/_cache/image/${encodeURIComponent(url)}`);
167	  const staleReq = new Request(`https://api.nasapicture.com/_cache/image/${encodeURIComponent(url)}:stale`);
168	
169	  const cached = await cache.match(cacheReq);
170	  if (cached) {
171	    log.push(`  [fetchImage] ${url.slice(0, 80)}… → cache HIT`);
172	    return cached;
173	  }
174	
175	  const res = await fetch(url);
176	
177	  log.push(`  [fetchImage] ${url.slice(0, 80)}… → ${res.status}`);
178	
179	  if (!res.ok) {
180	    // Try stale cache before giving up
181	    const stale = await cache.match(staleReq);
182	    if (stale) {
183	      log.push(`  [fetchImage] ${url.slice(0, 80)}… → stale cache fallback`);
184	      return stale;
185	    }
186	    throw new Error(`Image fetch failed: ${res.status}`);
187	  }
188	
189	  const contentType = res.headers.get("Content-Type") || "image/jpeg";
190	  const contentLength = res.headers.get("Content-Length");
191	  const cacheHeaders: Record<string, string> = {
192	    "Content-Type": contentType,
193	    "Cache-Control": `public, max-age=${CACHE_TTL}`,
194	  };
195	  if (contentLength) cacheHeaders["Content-Length"] = contentLength;
196	
197	  const staleCacheHeaders = { ...cacheHeaders, "Cache-Control": `public, max-age=${STALE_CACHE_TTL}` };
198	
199	  const arrayBuffer = await res.arrayBuffer();
200	  await Promise.all([
201	    cache.put(cacheReq, new Response(arrayBuffer, { headers: cacheHeaders })),
202	    cache.put(staleReq, new Response(arrayBuffer, { headers: staleCacheHeaders })),
203	  ]);
204	  return new Response(arrayBuffer, { headers: cacheHeaders });
205	}

218	  const staleReq = new Request(`${cacheKey}:stale`);

220	  const cached = await cache.match(cacheReq);
221	  if (cached) {
222	    log.push(`  [dimensions] ${imageUrl.slice(0, 80)}… → cache HIT`);
223	    return cached.json() as Promise<ImageDimensions>;
224	  }
225	
226	  try {

228	      cf: { image: { format: "json" } },

230	
231	    if (!res.ok) {
232	      const stale = await cache.match(staleReq);
233	      if (stale) {
234	        log.push(`  [dimensions] ${imageUrl.slice(0, 80)}… → stale cache fallback`);
235	        return stale.json() as Promise<ImageDimensions>;
236	      }
237	      log.push(`  [dimensions] ${imageUrl.slice(0, 80)}… → ${res.status} (failed)`);
238	      return null;
239	    }
240	
241	    const info = await res.json() as { original: { width: number; height: number } };
242	    const dimensions: ImageDimensions = {
243	      width: info.original.width,
244	      height: info.original.height,
245	    };
246	
247	    log.push(`  [dimensions] ${imageUrl.slice(0, 80)}… → ${dimensions.width}×${dimensions.height}`);
248	
249	    const body = JSON.stringify(dimensions);
250	    await Promise.all([
251	      cache.put(cacheReq, new Response(body, {
252	        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Cache-Control": `public, max-age=${CACHE_TTL}` },
253	      })),
254	      cache.put(staleReq, new Response(body, {
255	        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Cache-Control": `public, max-age=${STALE_CACHE_TTL}` },
256	      })),
257	    ]);
258	    return dimensions;
259	  } catch (err) {
260	    log.push(`  [dimensions] ${imageUrl.slice(0, 80)}… → error: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : "unknown"}`);
261	    const stale = await cache.match(staleReq);
262	    if (stale) return stale.json() as Promise<ImageDimensions>;
263	    return null;
264	  }
265	}

_**Agent - sidechain (claude-sonnet-4-6 2026-04-09 18:46:51Z)**_

Here are my findings on the new metadata routes:

**1. Caching - Inconsistency with `/info`**

The new routes call `fetchApod(log, apiKey)` directly (line 493), which correctly goes through the two-tier cache. However, there is a behavioral difference from `/info`: when today's APOD is a video, `/info` falls back to `findLatestImage` to get an image APOD, but the metadata routes do not. This means `/date`, `/title`, etc. may return metadata for a video day while `/info` returns metadata for the most recent image day. Whether intentional or a bug depends on the intent, but it is inconsistent.

**2. Link Headers - Redundancy Issue**

The four new routes are all added with `rel="describedby"`, which is the same rel type already used by `/info`. Having five `describedby` entries is semantically correct but makes the header noticeably long (now 10 entries total). More importantly, since `/info` already contains all these fields in structured JSON, the individual field routes are redundant from a discoverability standpoint. The header length is not a hard problem but is worth noting.

**3. Route Placement**

Placement after `/about` and before the 404 fallback is fine. No ordering concern.

**4. Consistency**

The new routes use `baseHeaders(origin, { "Content-Type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8" })` which matches `/about`. Response construction is consistent with existing patterns.

**5. API Design - The Core Question**

Individual field routes (`/date`, `/title`, `/explanation`, `/copyright`) are a reasonable pattern for zero-JS embed contexts (CSS `content:`, server-side `curl` pipelines, `<iframe>` fallbacks), which is the stated use case for this API. However:

- `/explanation` returns the full paragraph of text over plain text, which is useful, but also the highest-value field already in `/info`
- `/copyright` returning `"none"` as a sentinel string rather than an empty body or 204 is a minor API design choice worth noting -- callers have to know the sentinel

**Recommendations:**

1. **Fix the video-day inconsistency**: either have the metadata routes also call `findLatestImage` when `media_type !== "image"` (matching `/info` behavior), or document that these routes return today's APOD regardless of type. The current state silently diverges from `/info`.

2. **`/copyright` sentinel**: consider returning an empty body (with a note in `/about`) rather than `"none"` -- plain text consumers would need to distinguish "none" from an actual copyright holder named "none". An empty 200 or a 204 is less ambiguous.

3. **Link header bloat**: the four new `describedby` entries could be omitted from the Link header since `/info` (also `describedby`) already subsumes them. Or keep them and accept the verbosity -- it is not broken.

The caching path itself is correct (all four routes go through `fetchApod` which uses the two-tier cache). The video-day divergence from `/info` is the most actionable issue.

<teammate-message teammate_id="security-reviewer" color="green" summary="Security review findings for metadata routes">
## Security Review: New Metadata Text Routes

**Risk Level: LOW**
**Immediate Action Required: No**

### Findings

**No critical or high-severity issues found.** The implementation follows the same patterns as existing routes and is well-structured.

#### 1. Missing `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` header (LOW)
- **Location**: `baseHeaders()` at line 267
- **Impact**: Without this header, older browsers could theoretically MIME-sniff a `text/plain` response and reinterpret it. Modern browsers handle this correctly, but the header is a standard defense-in-depth measure.
- **Applies to**: All routes, not just the new ones. This is a pre-existing gap.
- **Remediation**: Add `"X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff"` to `baseHeaders()`.

#### 2. No runtime validation of NASA API response shape (LOW)
- **Location**: Line 116 -- `as ApodResponse` type assertion without validation
- **Impact**: If NASA ever returns `null` or omits a "required" field like `title`, the `/title` route would serve the literal string `"null"` or an empty body rather than a meaningful error. This is a pre-existing pattern shared with `/info`.
- **Applies to**: All routes that consume `ApodResponse`.
- **Remediation**: Optional. Could add a guard like `fieldMap[pathname] ?? ""` or a validation layer, but the NASA API is stable and this is extremely unlikely.

### What's Done Well

- **Content-Type is correct**: `text/plain; charset=utf-8` prevents XSS even if NASA data contained HTML/script content.
- **CORS is consistent**: Wildcard origin matches the existing public API pattern. No credentials are involved, so `*` is appropriate.
- **Copyright null handling**: `apod.copyright ?? "none"` correctly handles the optional field.
- **Input validation**: Route matching uses a fixed string array -- no user input is reflected in responses.
- **Error handling**: Exceptions from `fetchApod` are caught by the outer try/catch and returned as JSON errors.

### Design Note (not a security issue)

The new routes use `fetchApod()` (today's APOD) rather than `findLatestImage()` (which skips videos). On video days, `/title` and `/explanation` will return the video's metadata while `/` returns the previous day's image. This is arguably correct behavior for metadata routes, but worth confirming it's intentional.
</teammate-message>

Architecture review complete. Here are the findings for the four new metadata routes (/date, /title, /explanation, /copyright):

**Caching: Correct path, but behavioral inconsistency**
All four routes call `fetchApod(log, apiKey)` which correctly goes through the two-tier cache (6h primary + 24h stale). However, `/info` falls back to `findLatestImage` when today's APOD is a video, while the new routes do not. On video days, `/info` returns the most recent image APOD metadata, but `/date`, `/title`, etc. return today's video APOD metadata. This is a silent behavioral divergence.

**API design concern: `/copyright` sentinel**
Returning the string `"none"` for public domain works is ambiguous -- a caller can't distinguish a copyright holder literally named "none" from the no-copyright case. An empty body (200 with empty string) or a 204 would be less ambiguous. Minor, but worth a decision.

1. Fix the video-day inconsistency: either add `findLatestImage` fallback when `media_type !== "image"` (matching `/info`), or explicitly document that these routes return today's APOD unconditionally.
2. Reconsider the `/copyright` sentinel -- empty body is less ambiguous than the string "none".
3. Optionally trim the four new Link header entries since `/info` already subsumes them.

1	/**
2	 * APOD Proxy — Cloudflare Worker
3	 *
4	 * Serves NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day from a stable URL.
5	 * Uses Cloudflare's edge cache for both the API response and the
6	 * image bytes — no KV, no cron, no external storage.
7	 *
8	 * Routes:
9	 *   GET /          → today's APOD image (high res, falls back to standard)
10	 *   GET /sd        → today's APOD image (standard res)
11	 *   GET /optimized → optimized image (≤1200px, auto WebP/AVIF)
12	 *   GET /thumb     → tiny thumbnail (32px, blurred WebP)
13	 *   GET /info      → JSON metadata (includes image dimensions)
14	 *   GET /about     → plain-text description and attribution
15	 *   GET /date      → today's APOD date (plain text)
16	 *   GET /title     → today's APOD title (plain text)
17	 *   GET /explanation → today's APOD explanation (plain text)
18	 *   GET /copyright → copyright holder or "none" (plain text)
19	 */
20	
21	export interface Env {
22	  NASA_API_KEY?: string;
23	}

25	const NASA_APOD_URL = "https://api.nasa.gov/planetary/apod";
26	const MAX_LOOKBACK_DAYS = 7;
27	const CACHE_TTL = 21600;      // 6 hours — APOD changes once/day
28	const STALE_CACHE_TTL = 86400; // 24 hours — fallback when NASA API is down/rate-limited
29	
30	interface ApodResponse {
31	  date: string;
32	  title: string;
33	  explanation: string;
34	  url: string;
35	  hdurl?: string;
36	  media_type: "image" | "video";
37	  copyright?: string;
38	}

40	class NasaApiError extends Error {
41	  constructor(public statusCode: number, message: string) {
42	    super(message);
43	  }
44	}
45	
46	const inflightApod = new Map<string, Promise<ApodResponse>>();
47	
48	function apodCacheUrl(key: string): string {
49	  return `https://api.nasapicture.com/_cache/apod/${key}`;
50	}
51	
52	function todayET(): string {
53	  return new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-CA", { timeZone: "America/New_York" });
54	}
55	
56	async function fetchApod(log: string[], apiKey: string, date?: string): Promise<ApodResponse> {
57	  const resolvedDate = date ?? todayET();
58	  const cacheKey = resolvedDate;
59	
60	  const cache = caches.default;
61	  const cacheReq = new Request(apodCacheUrl(cacheKey));
62	  const staleReq = new Request(apodCacheUrl(`${cacheKey}:stale`));
63	
64	  const cached = await cache.match(cacheReq);
65	  if (cached) {
66	    log.push(`  [fetchApod] ${cacheKey} → cache HIT`);
67	    return cached.json() as Promise<ApodResponse>;
68	  }
69	
70	  // Deduplicate concurrent requests for the same date
71	  const inflight = inflightApod.get(cacheKey);
72	  if (inflight) {
73	    log.push(`  [fetchApod] ${cacheKey} → coalesced with in-flight request`);
74	    return inflight;
75	  }
76	
77	  const promise = fetchApodFromNasa(log, apiKey, resolvedDate, cacheKey, cacheReq, staleReq);
78	  inflightApod.set(cacheKey, promise);
79	  try {
80	    return await promise;
81	  } finally {
82	    inflightApod.delete(cacheKey);
83	  }
84	}

86	async function fetchApodFromNasa(
87	  log: string[], apiKey: string, resolvedDate: string, cacheKey: string,
88	  cacheReq: Request, staleReq: Request,
89	): Promise<ApodResponse> {
90	  const cache = caches.default;
91	  const url = `${NASA_APOD_URL}?api_key=${apiKey}&date=${resolvedDate}`;
92	
93	  const res = await fetch(url);
94	
95	  const cfCache = res.headers.get("cf-cache-status") ?? "none";
96	  log.push(`  [fetchApod] ${cacheKey} → ${res.status} (cf-cache: ${cfCache})`);
97	
98	  if (!res.ok) {
99	    const body = await res.text();
100	    log.push(`  [fetchApod] body=${body}`);
101	
102	    // Try stale cache before giving up
103	    const stale = await cache.match(staleReq);
104	    if (stale) {
105	      log.push(`  [fetchApod] ${cacheKey} → stale cache fallback`);
106	      return stale.json() as Promise<ApodResponse>;
107	    }
108	
109	    throw new NasaApiError(res.status,
110	      res.status === 429
111	        ? "NASA API rate limit exceeded — try again later"
112	        : `NASA API returned ${res.status}`
113	    );
114	  }

121	    cache.put(cacheReq, new Response(body, { headers: cacheHeaders })),
122	    cache.put(staleReq, new Response(body, { headers: staleHeaders })),
123	  ]);
124	  return apod;

127	async function findLatestImage(log: string[], apiKey: string): Promise<ApodResponse> {
128	  let videos = 0;
129	  let errors = 0;
130	
131	  for (let i = 0; i <= MAX_LOOKBACK_DAYS; i++) {
132	    const d = new Date();
133	    d.setDate(d.getDate() - i);
134	    const date = d.toLocaleDateString("en-CA", { timeZone: "America/New_York" });
135	
136	    try {
137	      const apod = await fetchApod(log, apiKey, date);
138	      if (apod.media_type === "image") return apod;
139	      videos++;
140	    } catch (err) {
141	      errors++;
142	      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "unknown";
143	      log.push(`  [findLatestImage] ${date} → error, skipping (${msg})`);
144	    }
145	  }
146	
147	  throw new Error(
148	    `No image found in last ${MAX_LOOKBACK_DAYS + 1} days (${videos} videos, ${errors} errors)`
149	  );
150	}

152	function validateImageUrl(url: string): void {
153	  const parsed = new URL(url);
154	  if (parsed.protocol !== "https:") {
155	    throw new Error(`Blocked image fetch: non-HTTPS scheme (${parsed.protocol})`);
156	  }
157	  if (!parsed.hostname.endsWith(".nasa.gov")) {
158	    throw new Error(`Blocked image fetch: unexpected host (${parsed.hostname})`);
159	  }
160	}

162	async function fetchImageCached(log: string[], url: string): Promise<Response> {
163	  validateImageUrl(url);
164	
165	  const cache = caches.default;
166	  const cacheReq = new Request(`https://api.nasapicture.com/_cache/image/${encodeURIComponent(url)}`);
167	  const staleReq = new Request(`https://api.nasapicture.com/_cache/image/${encodeURIComponent(url)}:stale`);
168	
169	  const cached = await cache.match(cacheReq);
170	  if (cached) {
171	    log.push(`  [fetchImage] ${url.slice(0, 80)}… → cache HIT`);
172	    return cached;
173	  }
174	
175	  const res = await fetch(url);
176	
177	  log.push(`  [fetchImage] ${url.slice(0, 80)}… → ${res.status}`);
178	
179	  if (!res.ok) {
180	    // Try stale cache before giving up
181	    const stale = await cache.match(staleReq);
182	    if (stale) {
183	      log.push(`  [fetchImage] ${url.slice(0, 80)}… → stale cache fallback`);
184	      return stale;
185	    }
186	    throw new Error(`Image fetch failed: ${res.status}`);
187	  }
188	
189	  const contentType = res.headers.get("Content-Type") || "image/jpeg";
190	  const contentLength = res.headers.get("Content-Length");
191	  const cacheHeaders: Record<string, string> = {
192	    "Content-Type": contentType,
193	    "Cache-Control": `public, max-age=${CACHE_TTL}`,
194	  };
195	  if (contentLength) cacheHeaders["Content-Length"] = contentLength;
196	
197	  const staleCacheHeaders = { ...cacheHeaders, "Cache-Control": `public, max-age=${STALE_CACHE_TTL}` };
198	
199	  const arrayBuffer = await res.arrayBuffer();
200	  await Promise.all([
201	    cache.put(cacheReq, new Response(arrayBuffer, { headers: cacheHeaders })),
202	    cache.put(staleReq, new Response(arrayBuffer, { headers: staleCacheHeaders })),
203	  ]);
204	  return new Response(arrayBuffer, { headers: cacheHeaders });
205	}

212	async function fetchImageDimensions(log: string[], imageUrl: string): Promise<ImageDimensions | null> {
213	  validateImageUrl(imageUrl);
214	
215	  const cache = caches.default;
216	  const cacheKey = `https://api.nasapicture.com/_cache/dimensions/${encodeURIComponent(imageUrl)}`;
217	  const cacheReq = new Request(cacheKey);
218	  const staleReq = new Request(`${cacheKey}:stale`);
219	
220	  const cached = await cache.match(cacheReq);
221	  if (cached) {
222	    log.push(`  [dimensions] ${imageUrl.slice(0, 80)}… → cache HIT`);
223	    return cached.json() as Promise<ImageDimensions>;
224	  }
225	
226	  try {
227	    const res = await fetch(imageUrl, {
228	      cf: { image: { format: "json" } },
229	    });
230	
231	    if (!res.ok) {
232	      const stale = await cache.match(staleReq);
233	      if (stale) {
234	        log.push(`  [dimensions] ${imageUrl.slice(0, 80)}… → stale cache fallback`);
235	        return stale.json() as Promise<ImageDimensions>;
236	      }
237	      log.push(`  [dimensions] ${imageUrl.slice(0, 80)}… → ${res.status} (failed)`);
238	      return null;
239	    }
240	
241	    const info = await res.json() as { original: { width: number; height: number } };
242	    const dimensions: ImageDimensions = {
243	      width: info.original.width,
244	      height: info.original.height,
245	    };
246	
247	    log.push(`  [dimensions] ${imageUrl.slice(0, 80)}… → ${dimensions.width}×${dimensions.height}`);
248	
249	    const body = JSON.stringify(dimensions);
250	    await Promise.all([
251	      cache.put(cacheReq, new Response(body, {
252	        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Cache-Control": `public, max-age=${CACHE_TTL}` },
253	      })),
254	      cache.put(staleReq, new Response(body, {
255	        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Cache-Control": `public, max-age=${STALE_CACHE_TTL}` },
256	      })),
257	    ]);
258	    return dimensions;
259	  } catch (err) {
260	    log.push(`  [dimensions] ${imageUrl.slice(0, 80)}… → error: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : "unknown"}`);
261	    const stale = await cache.match(staleReq);
262	    if (stale) return stale.json() as Promise<ImageDimensions>;
263	    return null;
264	  }
265	}

267	function baseHeaders(origin: string, headers: Record<string, string> = {}): Record<string, string> {
268	  return {
269	    "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
270	    "Cache-Control": `public, max-age=${CACHE_TTL}`,
271	    "Link": [
272	      `<${origin}/>; rel="alternate"; type="image/*"; title="HD image"`,
273	      `<${origin}/sd>; rel="alternate"; type="image/*"; title="SD image"`,
274	      `<${origin}/optimized>; rel="alternate"; type="image/*"; title="Optimized image"`,
275	      `<${origin}/thumb>; rel="alternate"; type="image/webp"; title="Thumbnail"`,
276	      `<${origin}/info>; rel="describedby"`,
277	      `<${origin}/about>; rel="about"`,
278	      `<${origin}/date>; rel="describedby"; title="APOD date"`,
279	      `<${origin}/title>; rel="describedby"; title="APOD title"`,
280	      `<${origin}/explanation>; rel="describedby"; title="APOD explanation"`,
281	      `<${origin}/copyright>; rel="describedby"; title="APOD copyright"`,
282	    ].join(", "),
283	    ...headers,
284	  };
285	}

## Steps

### 1. Review Board State

Parse the pre-loaded board data above. Identify:
- All items with `status: backlog` or `status: current` (candidates for completion)
- Epics and their child tasks (via `parent` field)
- Blocked items and their blockers
- Items with terminal status (`done`, `processed`) that should be archived
- Items missing a required `status` field (all types except `reference`)

### 2. Gather Codebase Context

- Run `git log --oneline` for recent commits (last 30) to understand what work has been done
- Only Read full file bodies for tasks whose status is `backlog` or `current` AND whose title suggests overlap with recent commits
- Use the context budget escalation (Glob → Grep → Read with limit → Full read) for any additional lookups

### 3. Detect Completed Work

For each task with `status: backlog` or `status: current`, check if the work described has already been done:

- Look at recent commits for evidence the work was completed
- Check the codebase for the feature/fix the task describes
- If the work is done, flag it for status update to `done`

### 4. Detect New Work Needed

Scan for things that should become tasks but aren't tracked yet:

- Check recent commits for TODOs or FIXMEs introduced in code
- Look at open epics — are there obvious next steps not yet captured as tasks?
- Check if any `blocked_by` dependencies have been resolved (unblocking tasks)

### 5. Update Epic Progress

For each active epic:

- Check if all child tasks are `done` — if so, flag the epic as `done`
- Check if any child tasks are `current` — if so, the epic should be `current`
- Update the task list in the epic body if tasks have been added/removed

### 6. Check for Stale Items

- Tasks marked `current` but with no related commits in the last 30 days
- Epics in `planning` with no child tasks
- Resources stuck in `inbox` or `processing`

### 7. Present Changes

Present ALL proposed changes as a single summary before making any edits:

```
## Board Update Proposal

### Status Changes → Archive
- TASK-0003: backlog → done → **archive** (cache-decoded-image: implemented in commit a1b2c3d)
- EPIC-0001: planning → current (has active child tasks)
- NOTE-0002: already processed → **archive**

### New Tasks Suggested
- "Fix FIXME in preprocessing.rs line 42" (found in recent commit)

### Missing Status
- TASK-0025: no status field (required for tasks)

### Stale Items
- TASK-0007: marked current but no activity in 45 days

### Unblocked
- TASK-0005: blocker TASK-0003 is now done
```

**Terminal-status items must be archived atomically.** When a status change results in a terminal status (`done` for tasks/epics, `processed` for resources/notes), the archiving step is bundled into the same proposal line — not presented as a separate action. Items already at a terminal status but not yet archived should also appear with an **archive** tag.

ADRs are the sole exception — they are never archived regardless of status.

**Avoid redundant invocations** — if this skill was already invoked earlier in the session and the board has not been modified since, reuse the previous board data instead of invoking again.

Ask the user to approve, reject, or cherry-pick which changes to apply. Then execute only the approved changes:

- **Status updates + archive**: For items reaching a terminal status, update the status field first, then immediately run `bash /Users/grant/Documents/Projects/BoardPM/plugin/scripts/archive-batch.sh ./board <file>` in the same step. Never leave an item with a terminal status outside `archive/`.
- **Status updates (non-terminal)**: Use `/board:board-edit` to update status fields
- **New tasks**: Invoke `/board:board-add` for each approved new task
- **Archive-only** (items already at terminal status): Run `bash /Users/grant/Documents/Projects/BoardPM/plugin/scripts/archive-batch.sh ./board <file1> <file2> ...` directly

7	# Add individual metadata routes
8	
9	Add dedicated routes for individual APOD metadata fields, so consumers can fetch just what they need without parsing JSON from `/info`:
10	
11	- `/date` — today's APOD date (e.g. `2026-04-05`)
12	- `/title` — image title
13	- `/explanation` — description text
14	- `/copyright` — copyright holder, or `none` if public domain
15	
16	Returns plain text (`text/plain; charset=utf-8`). Useful for shell scripts, widgets, and other lightweight integrations.
17	
18	## Implementation details
19	
20	### Routing
21	
22	All four routes live in `src/index.ts` alongside the existing route branches. Add a single block after the `/about` handler that matches any of the four paths, calls `fetchApod()` once, then returns the requested field. No `.jpg` aliases needed since these are text endpoints.
23	
24	```
25	} else if (["/date", "/title", "/explanation", "/copyright"].includes(pathname)) {
26	  const apod = await fetchApod(log, apiKey);
27	  const fieldMap: Record<string, string> = {
28	    "/date": apod.date,
29	    "/title": apod.title,
30	    "/explanation": apod.explanation,
31	    "/copyright": apod.copyright ?? "none",
32	  };
33	  res = new Response(fieldMap[pathname], {
34	    headers: baseHeaders(origin, { "Content-Type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8" }),
35	  });
36	}
37	```
38	
39	### Caching
40	
41	No new cache logic required. These routes call `fetchApod()`, which already caches the NASA API response with the standard 6h primary / 24h stale strategy. The `baseHeaders()` helper sets `Cache-Control: public, max-age=21600` on the response, so Cloudflare's edge and browsers will cache the plain-text responses too.
42	
43	### Response behavior
44	
45	- Uses `fetchApod()` (today's date), not `findLatestImage()`, since metadata should reflect whatever today's APOD actually is, even if it's a video.
46	- `/copyright` returns the literal string `none` when the field is absent (public domain images). An empty 200 response would be ambiguous for shell consumers piping output.
47	- Error handling falls through to the existing outer `catch` block, which returns JSON error responses with appropriate status codes (429 for rate limits, 502 otherwise).
